title: Old Bonebeak
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Egle Barthrone fletches her bolts with vulture quill, and the vultures of the Boneyard Roost have been taking Trevor's young goats.

About

Given byEgle Barthrone
Level35
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Vulture Quill ×2
  • Carrion Beak ×6
  • Bonebeak Plume ×1

Steps

  1. Talk to Egle Barthrone (outdoors near Agauton) to get the quest.
  2. Bring Egle Barthrone 2 vulture quills (2) - Vulture Quill at 1155, 249
    Bring Egle Barthrone 6 carrion beaks (6) - Carrion Beak at 1155, 249
  3. Kill 3 boneyard vultures (3)
  4. Kill Old Bonebeak at 1222, 936
    Bring Egle Barthrone Old Bonebeak's plume - Bonebeak Plume at 1151, 247

Rewards

Reward
Gold7,580
Character XP237,000
Quest points1

What Egle Barthrone says

Egle Barthrone: Good quills. Stiff, and neither one split. The beaks go to Trevor, who will grumble about the price and pay it.

Egle Barthrone: These birds nest at the Boneyard Roost, among the giant ribcages. The old ones there are twice the size of these, and the whole flock follows one of them: Old Bonebeak.

Egle Barthrone: Kill a few of the big boneyard vultures around him first. Then kill him and bring me his plume. I've watched it from a ridge for years and never had a clear shot.

Egle Barthrone: That's his. Look at the length of it.

Egle Barthrone: It's far too good for fletching. I'll wear it.

Egle Barthrone: Here's your pay, with Trevor's bounty in it. He says his goats are grateful. I doubt the goats noticed.

Handing it in
